comment: Three parameters are declared with no widget: the strike position across the head in both axes, and the muffle angle. The strike position is set by clicking the drawn head or by the two CV jacks, and the muffle angle only from a preset. The model runs one resonator per vibrating mode rather than a mesh over the disc, which is what makes the strike position a per-mode gain and the muffling the same calculation applied the other way round.
